bio: A painter and former primary-school teacher who believes every child can be an artist. She also teaches French through songs and games.
A patient tutor who loves stories and numbers equally. She helps students build confidence in reading, writing and problem solving.
A history enthusiast who brings the past to life with stories about Mauritius and the world. She also leads high-energy Dancehall sessions.
A former club athlete who coaches with a focus on fun and fitness. Beginners are always welcome on the court and in the pool.
A classically trained musician who teaches violin and piano to all ages, with a gentle approach that keeps practice enjoyable.
